description: Stores, recalls and sequences eight snapshots of the presets of any modules bound to it, and binds several modules at once.

params.text: Short-press applies this snapshot to the bound modules, or in write mode stores their current presets into it; long-press clears it, or sets the sequence length in read mode.
Read applies a snapshot by hand, Auto stores the current presets whenever a new snapshot is selected, and Write stores the bound modules' presets into the snapshot pressed.

inputs.text: Selects the snapshot: a trigger steps through the slots forward, reverse, ping-pong, at random or shuffled, or 0-10V or a volt-per-octave note picks one outright.
A trigger restarts the snapshot sequence at the first slot.

notes: fifteen +8 expanders to the right raise the total number of snapshots to 128.
nothing is stored or recalled until a module is bound from the context menu; the modules bound are drawn with a coloured outline.
menu: Bind module (left) — binds the module on the left; Bind module (select one), Bind modules (select multiple) and Bind modules (current selection) bind ones clicked or already selected.
Stability & performance mode — Safe locks audio processing while a preset loads, Unsafe loads without locking it, and Unsafe fast loads on a worker thread.
Port SLOT mode — the eight Trigger modes step through the snapshots, 0..10V and C4 pick one outright, Arm applies a snapshot pressed by hand on the next clock trigger, and Off ignores the port.
Bound modules — lists every bound module, each with Zoom to module and Unbind.
Number of slots — sets how many snapshots the sequence uses, with Set by long-press switching the long-press shortcut for it on and off.
Autoload — Off, First preset or Last active preset, applied whenever a preset of this module itself is loaded.
Modules outline — draws the coloured box around bound modules When selected, Never or Always, with a colour picker for it.
Save, Load, Clear, Copy, Paste, Randomize and save, Shift front, Shift back and Custom label — on a snapshot button's own right-click menu.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
